records.name: Water
records.description: Plain water with no meaningful calories.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

cautions: Individual fluid needs vary; excessive water intake can also be harmful.
records.servingSuggestions: Drink regularly according to thirst and activity.
records.selectionTips: Use safe drinking water from a reliable source.
records.storageTips: Store safely in clean covered containers.

records.name: Orange Juice, Unsweetened
records.description: Juice from oranges without added sugar.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

cautions: Juice contains less fibre than whole fruit and can provide substantial sugar per serving.
records.servingSuggestions: Prefer whole orange more often; keep juice portions moderate.
records.selectionTips: Choose 100% juice without added sugar when buying packaged juice.
